page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8v-tee-8x.16xlarge is a dedicated GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance configured for intensive parallel computing and machine learning workflows. Running on the KVM hypervisor, this instance provision is powered by Intel Xeon 8469C processors operating at a baseline frequency of 2.6 GHz. It provides 64 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs paired with 768.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core allocation of 12.0 GB per vCPU.

Hardware acceleration is anchored by an array of 8 GPUs delivering a combined 768 GB of video RAM. This large graphics memory footprint enables the processing of extensive parameter spaces directly in accelerator memory. Networking throughput is defined by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps, providing substantial capacity for distributed cluster synchronization, node-to-node communication, and pipeline ingress.

The configuration provides zero local storage out of the box, requiring reliance on external or networked block storage solutions for operating system images and persistent dataset management. Cost efficiency for this instance class is driven by its high accelerator density and balanced compute-to-memory footprint, eliminating idle resource bottlenecks for workloads that saturate both primary memory and multiple GPUs.

This server type is primarily structured for large-scale distributed deep learning training, massive AI model inference, high-performance scientific simulations, and parallelized computer vision pipelines requiring significant combined VRAM and dedicated CPU scheduling.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8v-tee-8x.16xlarge is a high-density, GPU-accelerated cloud instance engineered for demanding parallel compute workloads. Powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8469C processor clocked at 2.6 GHz under KVM virtualization, it provides 64 dedicated vCPUs alongside 768.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a generous 12.0 GB per core. The instance integrates 8 hardware GPUs offering a cumulative total of 768 GB of VRAM, making it capable of handling large-scale neural network architectures and memory-heavy accelerator tasks. It features a baseline network throughput of 32 Gbps for steady node-to-node communication, while containing no bundled local disk storage. Resource efficiency stems from consolidating massive GPU memory and dedicated compute within a single node, minimizing scaling overhead across distributed clusters. It is best deployed for deep learning training, LLM inference, scientific modeling, and high-throughput data processing pipelines.
